VoiceCallInsightReason.name: VoiceCallInsightReason
VoiceCallInsightReason.description: Represents the voice call insight reason that contains the insight keyword, insight moments associated with a keyword, and the number of keyword occurrences.

Name.description: The name of the insight reason.

OccurrenceInfo.description: The number of times the given keyword was mentioned in the call.

OccurrenceSnippet.description: The specific excerpt from the voice call transcript that helped generate the insight. Reserved for future use.

VoiceCallInsightId.description: Required. ID of the VoiceCallInsight data associated with a voice call. Each record represents the call insight of a specific recording or transcript within a call.

VoiceCallInsightReason.accessRules: the Conversation Insights for Sales permission set
